name: Antilles Current
scope: Conditional regional reference from OSW 26.5 N offshore-Abaco gate to OSW 28 N northwestward approach gate north of Little Bahama Bank. Both gates and all bends are editorial regional truncations, not observed current origins, terminations or a Gulf Stream junction. Southern Antilles, Florida Current, Gulf Stream, DWBC and eddy loops excluded.
layer: Modern mean-flow naming context in the upper 1000 dbar with a subsurface peak near 400 dbar at 26.5 N. No fixed-pressure axis or depth-following trajectory diagnosed. Pressure is not converted to metres; NASA surface animation is only geographic context.
time_convention: Undated conditional editorial connection around northern Bahamas. Meinen 2005-2015 mean evidence is local to 26.5 N; it does not date this full path. KN-200-4 (13 April-3 May 2011) did not detect the characteristic Antilles Current off Abaco while finding north-bank westward flow; these are not asserted to be one continuous observed current.
source_locator: Meinen et al. 2019, PDF pp1-3 and 18: regional naming, observation support and uncertainty. KN-200-4 report pp1/10: cruise dates, conditional modeled pathway and local non-detection.
source_citation: Meinen et al. (2019), Structure and Variability of the Antilles Current at 26.5 N, doi:10.1029/2018JC014836; RAPID/MOCHA KN-200-4 cruise report (2011).
source_license: Article identifies USA public-domain government status; cruise-report license not established. Original PDFs and page pixels excluded; only attributed facts and independent OSW geography packaged.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects both truncation gates and rounded intermediate bends for a conditional regional naming connection, with no diagnosed velocity axis. Alternative latitude bends and uniform longitude/independent endpoint-latitude offsets describe drawing choices, not current width, seasonal variability or source position errors.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Finite editorial bend sensitivity, not a seasonal axis, observed track or current edge.
Finite editorial bend sensitivity, not a seasonal axis, observed track or current edge.

scenario_rule: Three predeclared shapes crossed with three longitude shifts and independent three-value endpoint-latitude shifts: 81 retained editorial scenarios; no confidence or seasonal interpretation.
remaining_gates: Independently review identity, gates, bathymetry, pressure/layer correspondence and conditional continuity.
Acquire longitudinal velocity support before an observed axis or physical full-current length.
Whole-current width, annual dimension ranges and scientific admission remain open.
No surface-NASA depth/date match, physical state containment or occupied polygon inferred.
method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 81 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
